name: truncated-length-max-u16
meaning: A VALUE with LL=0 whose u16 length is 0xFFFF, the largest the short form can declare, followed by one byte. 65535 bytes is far below any frame-size bound, so the frame is short, not oversize: tr::frame::truncated (docs/reference/01-data-format.md §Truncation handling). A successful decode of this frame is a conformance FAILURE.
